description: issue #679 (SP7): with `sprites` active, `tell`/`ask`/`each` are profile reserved words, so redefining any of them as a PROCEDURE raises `ol-reserved-word` (spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154,179) — one diagnostic per `define`, each pointing at the procedure-name token with `namespace` `reserved`. `define` is one of the grammar's four declaration slots (spec/grammar.md:382), so this half is unaffected by maintainer ruling #833 and holds before and after it. Paired with reserved-procedures-without-sprites, which semantically CHECKS this exact source under Core alone and is clean: that pairing proved the reserved-word rule was gated on the active profile, a gate the ruling has since retracted (spec/grammar.md:408) — see that fixture's description and issue #841. Both fixtures are `"check": true` (semantic-checker only, no execution) because the rule is a checker rule — the procedures are never called, and no events are produced. Before this slice the rule was a normative MUST with no fixture at all.

diagnostics.message: tell is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
ask is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
each is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
